title: Community Guidelines
summary: The behaviour and content standards for everyone on CampusEduX.
intro: {{appName}} is a space for students to learn, build projects and prepare for placements. These Community Guidelines apply to everything you submit or do on the Service — reviews, resume and profile content, Custom Project Builder text, uploaded files, referral activity and support messages. They form part of the Terms & Conditions.
Breaking these guidelines can lead to content removal, feature restrictions, loss of rewards, or suspension or termination of your account.

sections.heading: 1. Be respectful
bullets: No harassment, bullying, threats or targeted attacks against any person.
No hate speech or content that demeans people based on religion, caste, gender, sexual orientation, disability, ethnicity, place of origin or similar characteristics.
No sexually explicit content, and no content that sexualises minors in any way.

sections.heading: 2. No spam or manipulation
bullets: No bulk, repetitive or irrelevant content, and no unsolicited advertising or promotion.
No fake, paid, incentivised or retaliatory reviews; review only what you have genuinely used.
No manipulation of the referral programme, wallet, rewards, ratings, leaderboards or analytics — including self-referrals, fake accounts and coordinated activity.

sections.heading: 3. No scams or fraud
bullets: No phishing, payment fraud, chargeback abuse, or attempts to trick other users or staff.
No selling, advertising or soliciting off-platform deals to avoid fees or protections.
No misuse of the job or application features — for example, fake listings, fake applications, or collecting other users' data.

sections.heading: 4. No impersonation or misrepresentation
bullets: Do not impersonate another person, a company, an institution or {{appName}} staff.
Do not misrepresent your identity, affiliation, qualifications or experience in your profile, resume or applications.

sections.heading: 5. Respect intellectual property
bullets: Only upload or submit content you have the right to use.
Do not post paid project source code publicly or share it with others (see the Project License Policy).
Do not remove required copyright or attribution notices, or pass off others' work as your own where that is dishonest.

sections.heading: 6. Keep it safe and legal
bullets: No malware, viruses, or files designed to harm devices or systems.
No content that is unlawful, promotes illegal activity, or facilitates cheating in violation of an institution's rules.
No attempts to break, probe or bypass the Service's security, rate limits or access controls.

sections.heading: 7. No misleading information
body: Do not post content you know to be false or misleading in a way that could harm others — including fake placement claims, fake company information, or misleading academic guarantees.

sections.heading: 8. Reporting violations
body: If you see content or behaviour that breaks these guidelines, email {{supportEmail}} with a description and, where possible, a screenshot and the location in the app. Reports are reviewed by our team. Do not file reports in bad faith.

sections.heading: 9. Moderation and enforcement
bullets: We may review, remove or restrict content that breaches these guidelines, with or without prior notice.
Depending on severity and history, we may warn you, remove content, limit features, reverse rewards or wallet amounts, or suspend or terminate your account.
Serious cases (fraud, threats, CSAM, illegal activity) may be reported to the relevant authorities.
If you believe an action was a mistake, you can appeal by replying to the notice or emailing {{grievanceEmail}}.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
bullets: Report content: {{supportEmail}}
Appeals / grievances: {{grievanceEmail}}
